note: The titles of the 34 tests in arena-rules.test.mjs of the JavaScript mockup, in file order, at commit 1e6531a128cdf339385c0ef5df27cf8d3d3eceab (removed, see the git history). A fixed list: no tool makes it again. tools/parity.test.mjs checks that test/test_arena_rules.gd has a counterpart for each title.
titles: arenas fill up in letter order, four agents each
an agent that comes back goes to its old arena if there is room
names go on after Z like spreadsheet columns, and back
arenas have no limit of their own; names go on after Z; a limit can be set
an empty arena closes after 30 s, never the last one, and its letter is used again
an agent leaves after 10 quiet minutes, unless a call or an approval is open
a tab shows the most urgent state of its agents
arenas sit in pages of four, each a 2x2 matrix, and the pages side by side
moves: a slide on a page, a fly to another page, a zoom, a scroll; a short cut with reduced motion
a fly to another page widens the view to a page midway; a slide on the same page does not
the view stays on the world: inside it up to the size of a page, centred on it when wider
a long move widens the view by about a page for each page it crosses, up to 8 rooms across
a new arena pulls the camera, after the hold
an approval pulls before a new arena, the oldest approval first, and each pull only once
by default a failure elsewhere does not move the camera
ordinary activity moves the camera only after 3 s of quiet and 5 s on screen
a pull for a finished turn expires after 10 s; an approval does not
in MANUAL nothing moves the camera; choosing an arena switches to MANUAL, F back to AUTO
the overview: Tab zooms out to the page, a click on an arena zooms into it in MANUAL, nothing moves meanwhile
Esc leaves the overview for the arena that was on screen; Tab needs two arenas
the overview scrolls page by page with ← and →, or to a page chosen in the list; Esc flies back
a click on a page in the list opens the overview there
N goes to the arena that needs you; ← and → step through the arenas, across pages too
a move that is turned midway starts from where the camera is
an arena that closes leaves a free place; a camera on it cuts to its left neighbour
an arena may open again under a letter that was closed
the overview of a page whose arenas have all closed cuts to the nearest page
the follow switch: failures and new agents pull only when ticked, and are not ticked by default
approvals only: a new arena, a failure, a finished turn or a new agent do not move the camera; an approval does
the follow menu ticks and unticks kinds; manual only and F switch between MANUAL and AUTO, which keeps its ticks
nothing ticked: the camera only moves when the person moves it
the pace: the camera moves by itself at most 3 times in any 10 s; the most urgent pull goes first when it may
approvals are let past the pace; other pulls are not
the pace can be changed or lifted, and it never limits the person
